propositions: Snapshot GC worker lock at `<snapshot-store>/gc/worker.lock` is not included in doctor's lock census, leaving stale locks invisible when the background worker dies
Doctor's lock census only scans tracker-adjacent locks and lacks the sixth leg for snapshot-GC worker locks on the per-host snapshot store
The snapshot-GC worker lock uses the same v2 ownership stamp and staleness adjudication as drain and compact-worker locks, so the shared `_existence_report` reader is correct

Store root derivation must remain read-only during diagnostic census to avoid creating directories for absent stores; `peek_store_root()` provides non-creating base resolution while `store_root()` retains mkdir/chmod behavior
A nonexistent store should report the snapshot-GC worker leg as free (absent lock file implies no lock held), matching the existing behavior for drain and compact-worker legs
